contentText: As the regional conflict between Israel and Iran enters a volatile new phase, a banned weapon of war is reappearing over civilian centers. While Israel’s defence systems remain robust, a new threat – the cluster ballistic missile – is testing the limits of safety. Unlike a single warhead, these missiles release hundreds of "bomblets," turning neighborhoods into active minefields long after the sirens stop. FRANCE 24’s Olivia Bizot reports.
